pick.name: llama.rn (llama.cpp for React Native)
pick.what: React Native binding for llama.cpp: GGUF LLMs, vision/audio via mmproj, tool calling, JSON-schema grammar, experimental TTS
pick.why: Most mature GGUF-on-phone path with an Expo config plugin; runs Gemma-4-E2B/E4B-class Q4 models on CPU; MIT
pick.maintained: npm dist-tag latest = 0.13.0-rc.8 on 2026-10-22 (still RC); >=0.10 requires RN New Architecture; Android arm64-v8a/x86_64 only
pick.install: npm i llama.rn (+ Expo config plugin; dev build needed)
pick.platforms: iOS|Android (Expo dev build; develop on macOS, Windows or Linux)

alts.name: react-native-executorch (Software Mansion)
alts.what: ExecuTorch for RN: Llama/Phi LLMs, VLMs, Whisper STT, Kokoro TTS, YOLO/SAM vision
alts.why: Wider modality set (STT+TTS+vision) in one lib; Expo supported via resource-fetcher companion
alts.license: npm metadata says MIT; docs page does not state

alts.name: LiteRT-LM (Google AI Edge) / Gemini Nano via ML Kit
alts.what: Google on-device LLM runtime: Gemma 4, Kotlin/Swift/JS/Python/C++; Android AICore Gemini Nano Prompt API
alts.why: Best native-Android performance (GPU/NPU); no RN binding so needs a native module
alts.free_limits: Gemini Nano subject to device support and ML Kit GenAI terms

candidates.name: llama.rn
candidates.verdict: Pick: GGUF, Expo plugin, tools+grammar, MIT; still RC

candidates.name: LiteRT-LM / Gemini Nano (ML Kit)
candidates.verdict: Alt: native Android, best HW accel; not RN

candidates.name: MediaPipe LLM Inference (@mediapipe/tasks-genai 0.10.30)
candidates.verdict: Web/Android; Google positions LiteRT-LM as the successor (inferred, not stated)

candidates.name: Apple Foundation Models
candidates.verdict: iOS 26+ Apple-Intelligence devices only; free; Swift-only, for later iOS (docs page content not retrievable)

decision: Choose llama.rn for first on-device features (summaries, classification, offline chat) with a 1-4B Q4 model; download size and RAM matter more than the library. Switch to react-native-executorch if you need on-device Whisper/Kokoro in one lib, or to native LiteRT-LM/Gemini Nano if you go Kotlin-native.
details: On-device quality is far below Claude; keep cloud fallback. Mid-range Android CPU speed unmeasured.

verify.note: 'Android now / iOS later; develop on Windows' is the previous single-user plan. Version 0.13.0-rc.8 (2026-10-22) still RC, MIT, confirmed.
